rawContent: Political alignments notwithstanding, #Blacklivesmatter leadership successful in harnessing collective resources of skills/knowledge/abilities/&financial resources to target a specific community and it's members with specific achievable goals and objectives?

#Juneteenth #BlackLivesmatter “Until You(we) realize, emotionally/spiritually/intellectually/&courageously, You(we) are responsible for (Y)our development, You/we will remain caretaker custodian within a framework that stunts (Y)our natural ascendency” Papa
